neighbours.label: the end of a fronted phrase that sets the case or group a statement is about ('when someone develops X,' 'at the equinoxes', 'in the adults', 'can be opened and'), right before the main clause's noun phrase begins with 'the'
fire: The iris sits in front of the lens. When a patient develops glaucoma, the pressure inside the eye rises.
The name is from Greek, because at the equinoxes the Sun crosses the equator.
If swallowing is hard, the tablets can be split and the halves taken with water.
The chicks are plain brown, whereas in the adults the wings carry white bars.
Carving a duck is simple if it is full grown; but in very young ducklings the legs are served whole.
The gland lies under the larynx. When a person develops goitre, the neck swells visibly.
The sachets may be torn open and the granules stirred into yoghurt.
The larvae feed on roots, whereas in the mature beetles the diet is mostly leaves.
quiet: The iris sits in front of the lens. The pressure inside the eye rises slowly with age.
The name is from Greek and means equal night in that language.
The tablets are white and the capsules are blue.
The chicks are plain brown and hide under ferns all day.
Carving a duck is simple with a sharp knife and a steady hand.
The gland lies under the larynx. It swells visibly during some illnesses.
She tore open the sachets and stirred her yoghurt.
The larvae feed on roots for two years before they emerge.

notes: Card: no single token; the output direction promotes ' the' / 'The' / ' their'. Probes: 'at the equinoxes [the day]' 0.50, 'develops cataracts, [the lens]' 0.39 with a preceding sentence but 0.15 without, 'opened and [the contents]' 0.47, 'crushed and [the powder]' 0.21; ordinary 'and the' 0.01. Weak and context-dependent: this may fail.
